main.scanDepthTitle: How far to look inside a folder
main.scanDepthHint: Applies to folders you add, drop, or name on the command line. A file you point at yourself is always taken.
main.dropHint:
Drop MP4 or M4V files here.

A folder brings in what is inside it, so you can drop a whole season at once.
main.renameEditTip: The name this file will get. Type over it to name this one file yourself.
main.renameRevertTip: Drop the name you typed and follow the template again
main.noApiKey: No TMDB API key yet. Open Settings and paste your key to start matching files.
main.badTemplate: Renaming is on but a rename template is invalid. Fix it in Settings, or turn renaming off.
main.waitingForKey: Waiting on a TMDB API key. Add one in Settings, then look these up.
pane.pickAFile: Pick a file on the left to see and edit its metadata.
pane.selectToReview:
Select a file to review its metadata.

Select several to edit the fields they have in common.
pane.sharedFields: Fields showing a value are the same across all of them. Editing one applies it to every selected file.
pane.languageTip: The language to fetch in. Applies to every selected file; press Refetch to pull the metadata again in it.
pane.refetchTip: Fetch the selected files' metadata again, keeping anything you have edited by hand.
pane.discardTip: Put everything back to what TMDB returned, including the type and the artwork. Nothing is downloaded again.
pane.searchByHandTip: With several files selected, the title you pick is applied to all of them. Each keeps its own season and episode.
pane.typeEditedTip: You set the type by hand. A refetch will keep it.
pane.fieldEditedTip: You edited this field. A refetch will keep it.
pane.filledFromEnglishTip: TMDB has no translation for this field in the chosen language.
pane.needsChoice: {0} of these files still need a title chosen. Search below to put one title on all of them.
pane.setSeasonEpisode: Set the season and episode, then use Refetch.
pane.addKeyFirst: Add a TMDB API key in Settings first.
artwork.chooseBlurb: This is the image embedded into the file when you apply. It is downloaded at the size set in Settings.
artwork.editedTip: You picked this artwork. A refetch goes back to the automatic choice.
artwork.none: TMDB has no artwork for this title.
field.title: Title
field.titleHint: For an episode this is the episode title.
field.episodeHint: Use 1-2 for a file holding two episodes.
field.resolutionHint: Read from the video itself. Used by the {resolution} rename token and the HD flag.
status.edited: Edited by you, ready to apply
settings.tmdbBlurb: Create a free TMDB account, then copy the v3 API key from your account settings under API.
settings.metadataLanguageHint: Used for every file by default. Any single file can be switched to another language in the preview pane, which is useful when a title has no translation.
settings.appLanguageHint: The language of this window and the rest of the interface, separate from the metadata language above. Takes effect when you restart the app.
settings.artworkSizeHint: The preview pane downloads this same size, so what you see there is what gets written.
settings.artworkKindHint: Picked automatically for every file. Not every title has every kind, so a missing one falls back to the next best. Any single file can be overridden by clicking its artwork in the preview pane.
settings.backup: Keep a .bak copy of each file before writing tags
settings.omitResolutionHint: For the resolutions your library treats as ordinary. {resolution} then renders as nothing, so write it inside an optional section, <[{resolution}]>, and the brackets go with it.
settings.illegalCharactersHint: Windows allows none of \ / : * ? " < > | in a filename, so they are taken out whatever platform you are on. A colon is the exception: it always becomes a dash, so a title never runs into its subtitle.
settings.clickToInsert: Click a field to insert it
settings.templateHelp: Numbers take digit padding: {season:00} gives 01. Dates take formats like {airDate:yyyy-MM-dd}. Text takes :upper, :lower or :title, and {resolution:short} writes 2160p as 4k. Wrap a part in angle brackets to drop it when empty, as in < - {episodeTitle}>. Square brackets are literal.
about.tagline: Fills the metadata of movie and TV files from The Movie Database.
about.tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
tmdb.noKey: No TMDB API key is configured. Add one in Settings.
tmdb.rateLimited: TMDB is rate-limiting these requests. Try again shortly.
tmdb.rejectedKey: TMDB rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
tmdb.timedOut: The request to TMDB timed out.
tmdb.noDetails: TMDB has no details for that title.
write.notTaggable: The file is not a container this app can tag.
write.noMetadataSection: The file has no MP4 metadata section and one could not be created.
write.damaged: The file's structure is damaged and cannot be tagged.
write.failed: The file could not be written: {0}
write.rereadFailed: The file could not be re-read after tagging: {0}
read.notTaggable: This file is not a container this app can read tags from.
read.damaged: The structure of the file is damaged and its tags cannot be read.
read.failed: The tags could not be read: {0}
diff.tip: The tags already in this file beside what the lookup returned. Click either side to choose which one Apply writes.
diff.upToDate: Nothing to change: the file already holds exactly this.
diff.untagged: The file holds no metadata yet; all of this will be added.
diff.nothingToWrite: Nothing to write yet: look this file up first.
diff.unreadable: What the file holds now could not be read: {0}
diff.useFile: Write the value the file already holds
diff.useTmdb: Write the value the lookup returned
template.pathSeparator: The template must not contain a path separator: files are renamed in place.
match.nothingToSearch: The filename gave nothing to search for.
match.noDetailsForBest: TMDB had no details for the best match.
token.title: Movie title, or the episode title for a TV file
token.episode: Episode number (a range for multi-episode files)
token.ext: File extension (added automatically if you leave it out)
settings.themeHint: Applies straight away, unlike the interface language.
match.severalMovies: Several movies match this name. Pick one.
match.noShow: No TV show on TMDB matches “{0}”.
match.severalShows: Several shows match this name. Pick one.
match.showButNoEpisode: Found the show, but not which episode. Set the season and episode.
match.noSuchEpisode: {0} has no season {1} episode {2} on TMDB.
write.unsupportedExtension: {0} files are not supported: only MP4 and M4V.
write.verifyTags: The tags did not survive being written.
write.verifyTitle: The title did not survive being written.
write.verifyShow: The show name did not survive being written.
write.backupFailed: The backup copy could not be created: {0}
template.unmatchedBrace: Unmatched '}}' at position {0}. Write '}}}}' for a literal brace.
template.unclosedOptional: Unclosed '<': every optional segment needs a matching '>'.
template.numberFormats: numbers take digit padding such as 0, 00 or 000.
template.dateFormats: dates take a format such as yyyy, yyyy-MM-dd or MMMM.
template.textFormats: text takes upper, lower or title.
template.textFormatsExtra: text takes upper, lower, title or {0}.
